title: L bracket
prompt: Make an L bracket from 5 mm plate, 30 mm wide along Y and centred on y = 0: a base flange 50 mm long along +X lying on z = 0, and an upright flange 40 mm high along +Z standing at x = 0, both measured to the outside of the bend. Round the inside corner of the bend with R4. Drill one 6 mm through hole in each flange, centred on that flange's outside face. Use parameters for the sizes.
